parent_method: effective_response_refined; retained production and all prior weights unchanged
objective: Adapt the existing layered method to currently supportable real-observation targets, not restart from bare CPOP and not claim an unavailable full physical duration benchmark.

lineage.CPOP: Exact previous native CPOP structural curves retained and shared with the baseline.
lineage.raw_features: Reuse the retained DF._model_features numerical block and the50-column local-response representation. Direction-normalized departure is explicitly an observation feature, not fabricated metered power or a counterfactual reference. Eight fixed pooled features feed a regularized model because there are only62 resolved training labels.
lineage.local_rescue: Retain parallel raw local evidence and old-positive preservation. Rescue only original no-positive cases, only if raw current/power evidence exists and the real-trained whole-event verifier accepts it. Never erase a single native point or replace an existing positive merely for being short.
lineage.qualification: Fit standard LogisticRegression C=.1,class_weight=balanced with StandardScaler on resolved training anchor labels, fourfold user-group OOF only for rescue threshold calibration. Threshold=max(.5,max OOF negative score+.01),capped1, not a calibrated probability or false-alarm guarantee. Original positives are not vetoed by this new verifier.
lineage.functional_calibration: Retain the previous direct-feature calibration approach, now calibrating observed recovery point/observed onset-to-recovery span, which actually has provisional real references. Generate a return candidate from previous-state10/90% power/current ranges expanded2 raw descriptive scales, then fit one convex mixing coefficient on22 training recovery brackets. The five coefficients0,.25,.5,.75,1 are the entire recovery selection. Snap final points to existing timestamps, not invented sub-sample data.
lineage.old_weights: No frozen simulation head is used outside its30min/q1.5/sigma.05/regular-grid domain. Old effective0.15kW qualification and cumulative/longest effective durations remain in the preserved parent but are unsupported in this real pilot because their truth/reference is absent. They are not renamed as the new observed span, reset to zero, or claimed transferred.

train_validation: Train only on96 original training windows:62 resolved anchor labels and22 recovery references. All original32 validation windows are already seen development data from the failed pilot, not a fresh blind test. Freeze the new source and parameters before this new branch outputs validation results. Report both classification and recovery/span differences versus original CPOP/LABS; all missing target estimates incur180s, unknown/NA are not negatives.
overfitting_control: One new method-family direction, fixed small feature set and fixed regularization, no addition of hundreds of features. No validation-result tuning. If developmental gains appear, prospectively select32 additional validation-role windows by pilot/timestamps/hash only, excluding overlapping old windows, annotate before generating any new-window model output and keep all cases. This is additional development confirmation, not unlocking the final test or independent physical gold.
support: Native real times,current,pilot,power; no resampling/stretching4min into30min, fake q, untreated reference prediction, missing-point fill or deletion. Previous operating level is an empirical observed context only. Quiet pilot yields no anchor applicability, not a negative class. Any unsupported source stays retained with explicit status.
adoption: This adaptation remains a research branch. No automatic replacement of the beneficial production method or claim of true field accuracy from provisional single-assistant labels, regardless of score. Final test and external test stay closed.
scope: First block only, original CPOP/LABS controls preserved. No report, reference prediction, second block, new dependency, GPU, file deletion, external messages, commit or upload.
